nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Parses argparse options, defaults the output directory to srcdir/dist and dispatches the chosen build strategy.

nodes.label: _select_build()
nodes.desc: Validates flag combinations (metadata vs report vs outdir) and picks the build function; no flags means sdist-then-wheel.

nodes.label: build_package_via_sdist()
nodes.desc: Builds an sdist first, then rebuilds the requested binary distributions from the extracted archive so artifacts ship what an sdist consumer gets.

nodes.label: build_package()
nodes.desc: Iterates distributions (sdist/wheel/editable) and returns the built artifact basenames.

nodes.label: _extract_sdist()
nodes.desc: Safety-checked extraction: tarfile.data_filter, exactly one top-level directory, and a PKG-INFO sanity check.

nodes.label: _write_report()
nodes.desc: With --report, writes versioned JSON with each artifact's name, path, kind, size and SHA-256, atomically via os.replace.

nodes.label: _bootstrap_build_env()
nodes.desc: Isolated mode: install build_system_requires, then the backend's get_requires_for_build extras. Non-isolated: run check_dependencies.

nodes.label: ProjectBuilder
nodes.desc: The PEP 517 consumer API class: validates the source dir, reads pyproject.toml and exposes prepare/build/metadata operations.

nodes.label: _parse_build_system_table()
nodes.desc: Enforces PEP 518 semantics: requires is mandatory when the table exists, build-backend defaults to setuptools legacy, backend-path is checked on disk.

nodes.label: _find_typo()
nodes.desc: difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.8 raises TypoWarning for near-miss keys like build-sytem.

nodes.label: check_dependencies()
nodes.desc: Unions build_system_requires with get_requires_for_build and yields unmet (chain) tuples for clear error reporting.

nodes.label: get_requires_for_build()
nodes.desc: Dispatches the get_requires_for_build_{sdist,wheel,editable} hook and returns the extra dependency set.

nodes.label: prepare()
nodes.desc: Calls prepare_metadata_for_build_wheel; returns None when the backend lacks the hook (HookMissing).

nodes.label: build()
nodes.desc: Invokes build_sdist / build_wheel (optionally with a metadata_directory) and returns the artifact path.

nodes.label: metadata_path()
nodes.desc: Metadata without a prepare hook: builds a real wheel and extracts the single .dist-info/METADATA directory from it.

nodes.label: _call_backend()
nodes.desc: Creates the output dir, calls the hook callback and rejects invalid basenames (., .., path separators) returned by backends.

nodes.label: BuildBackendHookCaller
nodes.desc: pyproject_hooks object held at _builder.py L217: every PEP 517 hook runs in a subprocess of the configured python_executable.

nodes.label: _wrap_subprocess_runner()
nodes.desc: Merges env.make_extra_environ() into every hook subprocess call so isolation applies to all backend I/O.

nodes.label: _handle_backend()
nodes.desc: Context manager translating BackendUnavailable and CalledProcessError into BuildBackendException with hook context.

nodes.label: DefaultIsolatedEnv
nodes.desc: Context manager creating a temp build-env-* venv (or a caller-supplied empty dir); removed on success, kept on failure for inspection.

nodes.label: _PipBackend
nodes.desc: Prefers outer pip >= 22.3 with --python, else virtualenv, else stdlib venv; enforces pip >= 19.1 (macOS variants) and uninstalls setuptools from the build env.

nodes.label: _UvBackend
nodes.desc: Opt-in --installer uv: creates a pip-less venv and runs uv pip install against its python executable.

nodes.label: _find_executable_and_scripts()
nodes.desc: Locates python.exe/scripts/purelib via sysconfig, handling distros that need the venv or posix_local scheme.

nodes.label: check_dependency()
nodes.desc: Recursive PEP 508 checker with cycle detection and a seen-set that memoizes satisfied diamond subtrees.

nodes.label: _ctx.run_subprocess()
nodes.desc: Streams subprocess output line-by-line when verbose; captures and replays it on failure otherwise.

nodes.label: exception types
nodes.desc: BuildException, BuildBackendException, BuildSystemTableValidationError, FailedProcessError and TypoWarning.

nodes.label: _compat.tarfile
nodes.desc: Supplies a tarfile with PEP 706 extraction filters: backports.tarfile below Python 3.11.5, stdlib otherwise.
